mapper.select: SELECT id,owner_id,idempotency_key,checksum,status,payload,report,created_at,allow_updates FROM import_batch WHERE owner_id=#{ownerId} AND idempotency_key=#{key}
SELECT id,owner_id,idempotency_key,checksum,status,payload,report,created_at,allow_updates FROM import_batch WHERE id=#{id} FOR UPDATE
SELECT id,status,report,created_at FROM import_batch WHERE owner_id=#{id} ORDER BY created_at DESC
mapper.update: UPDATE import_batch SET status=#{status},report=CAST(#{report,typeHandler=cn.zhijie.config.JsonNodeTypeHandler} AS jsonb) WHERE id=#{id}
UPDATE import_batch SET status='QUEUED',allow_updates=#{allow} WHERE id=#{id}
mapper.select: SELECT id FROM import_batch WHERE status='QUEUED' ORDER BY created_at LIMIT 4
SELECT id,status,report,created_at FROM import_batch WHERE owner_id=#{id} ORDER BY idcreated_at ASCDESC, id ASC LIMIT #{query.size} OFFSET #{query.offset}
SELECT count(*) FROM (SELECT id,status,report,created_at FROM import_batch WHERE owner_id=#{id}) page_count
